RS0232 स्वेदन svedana one of the process applied in purification/refining of the material
DG0342 स्वेदनं svedanaṁ substances used for swedan (sudation)
RS0233 स्वेदनी यन्त्र svedanī yantra An apparatus used for steaming / fomenting
DG0340 स्वेदापनयनं svedāpanayanaṁ substances that reduces excessive sweating
DG0343 स्वेदोपग svedopaga substances which facilitates swedan (sudation)
